map.肺功能 FEV1/FVC 分级器 使用指南: Pulmonary Function FEV1/FVC Grader User Guide
map.根据肺量计测定数据计算 FEV1/FVC 比值，判读通气功能障碍类型及 GOLD: Compute the FEV1/FVC ratio from spirometry readings to interpret the type of ventilatory dysfunction and the GOLD severity grade
map.：比值=1.5/3.0=50%<0.7→阻塞性；FVC%pred≥80 不支持限: Ratio = 1.5/3.0 = 50% < 0.7 -> obstructive; FVC%pred >= 80 does not support restriction.
map.：比值正常但 FVC%pred<80→限制性通气障碍，查 TLC。: A normal ratio with FVC%pred < 80 -> restrictive ventilatory dysfunction, check TLC.
map.本工具 cutoff 可设(默认 0.7)，老年建议按 LLN。: The cutoff here is adjustable (default 0.7); for older people use the lower limit of normal.
map.比值低且 FVC 低为混合性，需 TLC/DLCO 确认。: A low ratio with a low FVC indicates a mixed pattern, which needs TLC or DLCO to confirm.
